design_basis: 项目指挥/规程/动作执行器底层逻辑.md v1.0

coordinate_convention.x: from shaft towards handle end at the recorded valve angle
coordinate_convention.tool: physical S-hook body origin; local +Y sketch up, +Z shaft to tip
coordinate_convention.tcp: existing S-tool ee_control site, distinct from surface contact point

method.orientation_reference: all user-confirmed actual relative rotations, interpolated by measured valve angle
method.note: Range added as approved data requirement; no execution or contact relocation occurs in V1.
